label: Visiting student

coverage.statement: Visiting international students may be on CISI coverage instead of Yale Health. Anything beyond that goes to Member Services at (203) 432-0246.
coverage.source: Yale Summer Session Health and Safety page (visiting international students enrolled in person in Yale Summer Session are enrolled in and charged for CISI); Yale Office of International Students & Scholars Health Care page lists CISI as a plan international students have used. Other visiting programs: ask OISS or Yale Health.
